sections.name: sourceSnapshotBundle
sections.title: Building the source bundle
sections.what: Finds every stored source document that a run referenced, loads those documents, checks each stored text against its recorded fingerprint, and returns the texts that pass with a list of gaps for those that do not.
sections.why: Stated in the comment: only references already held by the run are resolved.
sections.watch_out: Texts that fail the fingerprint check are returned with no text, which can surprise someone expecting the content.

summary: Packages the stored text of the sources a research run used into a bundle, and checks that each stored text still matches the fingerprint recorded when it was captured.
purpose: Lets someone later read exactly what the run relied on, with proof the text has not changed.
why: Stated in the comment: only documents the run already references are looked up, never an arbitrary request. Legacy runs with only web addresses are not treated as archived.
how: First, walk the saved run summaries and collect every document identifier and its recorded fingerprint. Second, if none exist, return a notice. Third, load only those documents from the stored documents table. Fourth, compare each stored text's fingerprint with the recorded one and mark it matched or mismatched. Fifth, list missing or mismatched documents as gaps.
inputs: A list of saved run summaries, of unknown shape, searched recursively for document identifiers and fingerprints.
outputs: A bundle with a version number, a list of snapshots (identifier, address, capture time, title, publisher, type, status code, fingerprint, integrity result, and text only if it matches), a gaps list, and a note that this is captured text, not current access or endorsement.
risks: Database errors are not caught here, so a failed query would stop the bundle. Text is withheld when the fingerprint does not match, which can look like missing content. The search through run data is recursive and depends on field names being consistent.
debug: If a snapshot shows the mismatched status, the stored text changed or is missing; the gaps list names the document. If nothing is returned, check whether the run summaries contain document identifiers. The stored documents table is the place to look.
